premise: In the morning fog Raccoon hides by covering his eyes; Badger digs for him, Fox listens, and Raccoon peeks out from behind his paws right under Fox's nose and says BOO.
inspiration: The hide-and-seek of folk games and Blind Man's Buff, gentled: the fog hides, but the finding happens nose to nose and ends in laughing.
lesson: The best surprises end with everyone laughing.

en-US.title: Raccoon Hides in the Fog
en-US.text: {canvas:fog 0.7 35s} [whispers] One morning, a soft white fog rolled into the forest. Everything went fuzzy and quiet. {raccoon:enter} Raccoon came padding out. {raccoon:face happy} [excited] Hide-and-seek time! {fox:enter} Fox trotted up and {fox:pulse} counted. One, two, three… Raccoon {raccoon:live hold} rubbed his paws and hid… by covering his eyes. [giggles] {raccoon:shake 0.3} If I can't see Fox, Fox can't see me! Fox {fox:go to raccoon} looked behind the {sfx:rustle} bushes. {fox:face sad} Only fog. {badger:enter} Badger came trotting by to help. Maybe he's down here! {badger:live} Badger sniffed, {sfx:dig} dug and dug, pushed his nose into the hole… and popped up with earth on his nose. {badger:face happy} Not down here! So Fox stood still. {fox:live} He pricked up his ears, closed his eyes and listened… then smiled, and swished his tail. A tiny giggle, right in front of his nose! {fox:face surprised} [slowly] Raccoon? {raccoon:live resume} Raccoon peeked through his paws, flung them open… BOO! {fox:spin} [laughs] Fox spun round. {all:face happy} {all:hop} Found you! said Fox. No, giggled Raccoon, I found YOU!

es-ES.title: Mapache se esconde en la niebla
es-ES.text: {canvas:fog 0.7 35s} [whispers] Una mañana, una niebla blanca entró en el bosque. Todo se volvió borroso. {raccoon:enter} Mapache salió andando. {raccoon:face happy} [excited] ¡A jugar al escondite! {fox:enter} Zorro llegó trotando y {fox:pulse} contó. Uno, dos, tres… Mapache {raccoon:live hold} se frotó las patitas y se escondió… tapándose los ojos. [giggles] {raccoon:shake 0.3} ¡Si yo no veo a Zorro, él no me ve a mí! Zorro {fox:go to raccoon} buscó detrás de los {sfx:rustle} arbustos. {fox:face sad} Solo niebla. {badger:enter} Tejón llegó trotando a ayudar. ¿Estará aquí debajo? {badger:live} Tejón olfateó, {sfx:dig} cavó y cavó, metió el hocico en el hoyo… y asomó con tierra en la nariz. {badger:face happy} ¡Aquí abajo no está! Zorro se quedó quieto. {fox:live} Levantó las orejas, cerró los ojos y escuchó… sonrió y movió la cola. ¡Una risita, justo delante de su nariz! {fox:face surprised} [slowly] ¿Mapache? {raccoon:live resume} Mapache miró entre sus patitas, las abrió… ¡CUCÚ! {fox:spin} [laughs] Zorro giró en redondo. {all:face happy} {all:hop} ¡Te encontré!, dijo Zorro. ¡No, se rio Mapache, yo te encontré a TI!

rustle.prompt: a small animal rustling gently in leafy bushes, soft and playful

dig.prompt: small paws scrabbling quickly in soft earth, little clumps of soil landing on grass
